name: campusfind
description: Campus lost property and recovery platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev:lan --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate -w backend && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend -- --watch=false
